class_guess: Binary counter over a block list with re-pairing overflow (TM21-like Skelet 1-like Class 2)
summary: Binary counter on (10)^u[00](01)^v blocks; carries + re-pairing overflow explain every step to 1e9
mechanism: Tape = digits (10)^u J (01)^v (J = 00: bit 0, empty: bit 1), then a growing (10)^a 000 (10)^b block at the right end.
Every 4 right records = +1: the head runs left to the first 0-bit (ruler-depth carry); each touched v drops by 1.
All bits 1 -> overflow: a run to the far left re-pairs the blocks. A digit whose v runs out fuses with its neighbour.

rules.name: M_k carry (k = trailing 1-bits)
rules.cases: k=0..5 tested; needs v_i>=1 (i<=k), u_i>=1 (i<k), u_k>=0, a>=1, b>=0; v=1 gives a fused (merged) digit

rules.name: O overflow (all bits 1)
rules.cases: n=1..7 tested; needs v_i>=1 (i<n); left edge moves 3 cells; counter restarts at 1

rules.name: init (blank tape to first K)
rules.cases: twins: start B -> K((1,2);2,1) in 122 steps; start C -> K((1,1);2,1) in 101 steps

template.diff: 10 of 12 transitions differ under the best renaming/mirror (Sk1like_TC_v2 TM1: 9 of 12)
template.note: Same architecture (LIncs = carries, Ov = re-pairing overflow, BigStep), but TM21's S' configs never recur here (0 real hits in 2e5 steps, all 6 states). Its LWF invariant fails: here digits run out and merge.

strategy: Copy TM21's shape: K(list,a,b) as a Fixpoint over (u,bit,v) blocks; prove M_k by induction on k (like LIncs_spec) and O by induction on the list (like Ov_spec) from es-level sweep lemmas. Then nonhalt via multistep_nonhalt + progress_nonhalt_cond with a merge-aware invariant that keeps every v reached by a carry >= 1. Same rules give the 2 twins (new init lemmas only).
risks: Invariant is the real work: digits do run out and merge (9 -> 5 digits in one cycle); TM21's LWF does not carry over.
Twin on the 'worked on extensively' tab (hipparcos, Oct 2025 thread) is this same table: duplicate-work risk until he answers.
Size: list bookkeeping plus merge cases likely 20-50 KB of Rocq (TM21 is ~300 lines).
